inventory.description: One diagram, two long vertical plates facing each other, left and right. A horizontal lead extends outward from each plate at approximately mid-height. No axis, grid, distance bracket, numeric length or subfigure letter is visible.
inventory.modernizationAllowance: Regularize line thickness and plate length; do not turn outward leads into field arrows.

inventory.description: The left plate is negative and the right plate positive. Six short minus marks occur just inside the left plate, and six plus marks just inside the right plate. Outside the upper ends the left label is -|q| and the right label is +|q|, expressing equal charge magnitudes and opposite signs.
inventory.modernizationAllowance: Keep mathematical signs and q notation; no translation or invented charge value is needed.

inventory.description: Six horizontal field lines span the gap between the plates in six vertically separated rows. Every arrowhead points left, from the positive right plate toward the negative left plate. The endpoints are incident on the facing plates; there are no rightward arrows or curved lines.
requiredFacts: both plate incidences for each arrow
inventory.modernizationAllowance: Regularize row spacing without adding a scale or a measured separation.

inventory.description: An E sits above the upper field line near the horizontal center, with a separate small right-pointing vector accent above the E. This accent denotes a vector and is not a seventh field-line arrow; it does not reverse the leftward physical field.
requiredFacts: visible right-pointing vector accent over E
notation arrow distinct from field arrows
inventory.modernizationAllowance: Deterministic vector accent is acceptable if the E and its accent read as one vector notation without a missing-glyph box.

sourceRelations: Both plates occupy one shared diagram; do not split the field and charge labels into separate panels.
The sign at every plate remains consistent with its external signed absolute-q label.
All six physical arrows go from the positive plate to the negative plate.
Field arrows meet the facing plates and do not point into the outward connection leads.
The E vector label stays above the field and is distinct from charge labels.
sourceAbsentFacts: No distance label or numerical value.
No force arrow, potential value, worked answer, formula or additional explanatory sentence.
No cultural wording or decorative symbol.
uncertainty: Pixel spacing and line lengths are schematic, not given measurements. Counts, signs, direction, incidence and vector notation are the source-bound facts.
